hero.headline:
Help arrives
through people.
hero.sub: Send a request. Appear on the map. Let your community respond.

problem.heading: Many people face emergencies alone.
problem.body: When something goes wrong, the help you need is often closer than you think — just unreachable.

cards.lost_desc: Disoriented in an unfamiliar place with no clear way to signal where you are.
cards.stranded_desc: A breakdown, a missed connection, no transport and nightfall closing in.
cards.unsafe_desc: A situation turns and you need eyes on you, fast, from people nearby.
cards.needAssistance_desc: Not an emergency for the line — but you still can't do this alone.

steps.sendRequest_desc: Describe what you need in a sentence. No account required to ask.
steps.appearOnMap_desc: Your request surfaces as a live dot for trusted neighbours nearby.
steps.receiveHelp_desc: A verified responder accepts, and you track them to you in real time.

liveMap.heading: A neighbourhood that answers.
liveMap.body: Every dot is a real person — someone asking, someone on their way.

values.trust_desc: Verified neighbours, not strangers from nowhere.
values.localImpact_desc: Help that stays in the streets you actually walk.
values.sharedResponsibility_desc: Today you respond; tomorrow someone responds for you.
values.humanConnection_desc: A name, a face, a hand — not a hotline.

features.heading: Built for the moment it matters.

items.communityResponders_desc: Real neighbours who opted in to help, vetted and close by.
items.anonymousRequests_desc: Ask for help without an account, a name, or a payment.
items.statusUpdates_desc: See exactly when a responder accepts, departs, and arrives.
items.realtimeLocation_desc: Your pin updates live so responders always know where you actually are.

trust.heading: Care, with guardrails.
trust.body: Openness only works when it's safe. These are the systems that make trust possible.

items.verification_desc: Responders are identity-checked before they can ever accept a request.
items.moderation_desc: A live team and community flags keep the map honest, around the clock.
items.privacy_desc: Your exact location is shared only with the responder you accept — no one else.
items.responseTracking_desc: Every interaction is logged and traceable, so help stays accountable.

cta.heading:
Nobody should face
emergencies alone.
cta.sub: Free to join · Available wherever neighbours are

footer.tagline: A community help network where the nearest hand finds you on the map.
